vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: bmi
Version: 1.0.1

The BMI skill is a local health-tracking utility that logs user-provided data to text files in the user's local directory (~/.local/share/bmi/). Analysis of scripts/script.sh and SKILL.md reveals no network activity, data exfiltration, or unauthorized file access. While the script contains a logic bug where the data export function is unreachable due to a duplicate case statement, there is no evidence of malicious intent or prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with a local-only BMI tracking utility: it stores data under ~/.local/share/bmi, has no network calls, asks for no credentials, and does not request elevated or persistent platform privileges.

dimensions.detail: Name/description claim a local BMI tracking tool and the included script implements exactly that: creating ~/.local/share/bmi, logging entries, producing exports, and printing stats. There are minor metadata inconsistencies (SKILL.md and script report v2.0.0 while registry shows version 1.0.1), but these are not security-critical.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs users to run a 'bmi' CLI (help/status/stats/etc.). The package includes scripts/script.sh which implements the CLI behavior, but there is no install spec telling how/where to install that script as 'bmi'. The runtime instructions stay within the stated purpose and only read/write files under the DATA_DIR; they do not request other system data or network access.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install specification is provided (instruction-only), which is low-risk. A shell script is included but not automatically installed. Because the repository includes executable code, a user or agent would need to place the script on PATH or execute it explicitly; this is expected for a CLI tool but worth noting.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables or credentials. The script uses HOME to derive ~/.local/share/bmi which is appropriate and proportionate to its purpose. No secrets, cloud keys, or unrelated variables are requested or accessed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always: false and the skill does not modify other skills or system-wide configs. It creates and writes files under the user's home directory (~/.local/share/bmi), which is normal for a user-level CLI tool.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This appears to be a local-only BMI tracking script and is coherent with its description. Before installing or running: (1) inspect scripts/script.sh yourself (it’s included) to confirm no unexpected network calls (none are present), (2) note that data will be stored at ~/.local/share/bmi so move or protect that folder if it will hold sensitive info, (3) the SKILL.md references a 'bmi' command but there is no install step—you’ll need to place the script on your PATH or run it explicitly, and (4) verify the publisher/website if you care about provenance (metadata shows BytesAgain but registry version and file version differ). If you want additional assurance, run the script in a restricted environment or container first.
